content.text:
Findings below, all verified by reading the code.

## Q-h12 — Default install: which code runs the memo INSERT

**Default driver value (two sites, both "sqlite"):**
- `/bench/repo/cmd/memos/main.go:122` — `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")`
- `/bench/repo/cmd/memos/main.go:130` — `rootCmd.PersistentFlags().String("driver", "sqlite", "database driver")` (bound to viper at `/bench/repo/cmd/memos/main.go:151`)
- Read into the profile at `/bench/repo/cmd/memos/main.go:43` (`Driver: viper.GetString("driver")`)
- Corroborating default-path logic: `/bench/repo/internal/profile/profile.go:110` — when `p.Driver == "sqlite" && p.DSN == ""`, the DSN is synthesized as `<data>/memos_prod.db` (or `memos_demo.db` in demo mode), i.e. sqlite is the assumed default and needs no DSN flag.

**Factory switch:**
- `/bench/repo/store/db/db.go:14` `NewDBDriver(profile)`, switch at `/bench/repo/store/db/db.go:18`; `case "sqlite"` at `:20` returns `sqlite.NewDB(profile)` (`/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:23`). Called from `/bench/repo/cmd/memos/main.go:57`, result passed to `store.New(dbDriver, instanceProfile)` at `/bench/repo/cmd/memos/main.go:64`.

**Concrete INSERT path for a saved memo:**
1. RPC: `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70` `(*APIV1Service).CreateMemo`
2. Store facade (only validates UID, then delegates): `/bench/repo/store/memo.go:109-113` → `s.driver.CreateMemo(...)` (interface method declared at `/bench/repo/store/driver.go:29`)
3. Concrete executor: `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16` `(*DB).CreateMemo`, statement built at `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo.go:40`:
   `INSERT INTO `memo` (...) VALUES (...) RETURNING `id`, `created_ts`, `updated_ts`, `row_status`` executed via `d.db.QueryRowContext` at `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo.go:41`.

Determination = `main.go:122/130` default `"sqlite"` → `db.go:20` switch case → `sqlite.DB.CreateMemo`. The mysql/postgres siblings (`/bench/repo/store/db/mysql/memo.go:16`, `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/memo.go:16`) are dead code in a default install.

## Q-h13 — Markdown processing

There is **no** `gomark` module and no `plugin/` directory in this commit. `go.mod:33` pulls `github.com/yuin/goldmark v1.8.2`; markdown lives in the in-repo package `/bench/repo/internal/markdown`.

**Interface:** `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:31` `type Service interface` with methods `ExtractAll` (:33), `ExtractTags` (:36), `ExtractProperties` (:39), `RenderMarkdown` (:42), `RenderHTML` (:45), `GenerateSnippet` (:48), `ValidateContent` (:51), `RenameTag` (:54).

**Only concrete implementation:** unexported `service` struct at `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:58` wrapping a `goldmark.Markdown`; methods at `:143` (ExtractTags), `:193` (ExtractProperties), `:244` (RenderMarkdown), `:255` (RenderHTML), `:264` (GenerateSnippet), `:349` (ValidateContent), `:356` (ExtractAll), `:425` (RenameTag). No mocks/alternate implementations exist (grep for `ExtractAll(content []byte)` hits only this file).

**Constructor:** `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:83` `NewService(opts ...Option) Service` — builds goldmark with `extension.GFM` plus optional in-repo extensions `extensions.TagExtension` and `extensions.MentionExtension` (`/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:93-101`), and `parser.WithAutoHeadingID()`.

**Runtime construction site (production):** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51` inside `NewAPIV1Service`, with both `WithTagExtension()` and `WithMentionExtension()`; stored on the field `MarkdownService markdown.Service` (`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`, set at `:56`). `NewAPIV1Service` is called at `/bench/repo/server/server.go:76`. (Test-only constructions: `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44`, `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss_test.go:54`, `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go:427`.)

**Holders/users of the interface:**
- `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`
- `RSSService.MarkdownService` — `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go:45`, injected from the API service at `/bench/repo/server/server.go:85`; used for feed HTML at `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go:339` (`RenderHTML`).
- `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` — `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16` (constructor `:19`; note: `NewRunner`/`RunOnce` have no production call site in this commit — only `RebuildMemoPayload` is used directly).
- Mention resolution: `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:32` (`ExtractAll` → `data.Mentions`).
- Snippet generation: `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-89` `getMemoContentSnippet` → `GenerateSnippet(content, 64)`.
- Payload computation: `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:80` (`ExtractAll`).

Parsing is `s.md.Parser().Parse(text.NewReader(content))` (`/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:116-120`); "restore" equivalent is `RenderMarkdown` via the in-repo renderer `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/renderer` (`markdown.go:250-251`).

## Q-h14 — Derived memo metadata

**Computation site:** `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74` `RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service)`. It calls `markdownService.ExtractAll` at `:80` and assigns `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property` at `:85-86` (it does **not** touch `Payload.Location`, so a location survives rebuild only because the same payload object is reused).

The actual extraction is the single AST walk in `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:356` `ExtractAll`:
- Tags — `:377-379` (from `mast.TagNode`, skipping tags inside links/images via `asMemoTagNode` at `:136`), deduped case-preserving at `:418`
- Mentions — `:380-382` (lowercased, deduped; used for notifications, not stored in payload)
- `Property.Title` — `:385-390`, first block child being an H1
- `Property.HasLink` — `:394-395` (`gast.KindLink`)
- `Property.HasCode` — `:397-398` (`KindCodeBlock`, `KindFencedCodeBlock`, `KindCodeSpan`)
- `Property.HasTaskList` — `:400-401` (`east.KindTaskCheckBox`)
- `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` — `:402-405` (any unchecked checkbox)

Property field set is defined in `/bench/repo/proto/store/memo.proto:15-22`: `has_link`, `has_task_list`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks`, `title`.

**Triggers for recomputation (only two in production code):**
1. Memo creation — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`, before `s.Store.CreateMemo` at `:115`. Location is layered on afterwards at `:112`.
2. Memo update, only when the `content` field is in the update mask — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` (inside the `path == "content"` branch starting `:437`), feeding `update.Payload = memo.Payload` at `:451`.
   - Note the `location` branch at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:481-484` sets `update.Payload` too, but does not recompute derived properties.
3. Comment creation reaches trigger #1 indirectly: `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:56` calls `s.CreateMemo(...)`.
4. Bulk/backfill path (defined but currently unwired): `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:52` inside `Runner.RunOnce`, which rebuilds every memo in batches of 100 and persists via `UpdateMemo` at `:56`.

**Snippet is not stored in the payload** — it is computed on demand at response-conversion time: `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:76-80` (single memo) and `:225` / `:248` (batch relation conversion, gated on `includeSnippets`), all through `getMemoContentSnippet` (`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83`, max length 64). Tags are read back from the stored payload at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:48`, and aggregated for user stats at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:138` and `:254`.
